title: Knowledge Shelf Workflow
description: Schema for Knowledge Shelf workflow definitions (workflows/<name>.json).

source.description: Relative file or directory path inside the knowledge unit folder (for copy, copy_dir).

target.description: Target destination path starting with a root placeholder prefix, e.g. {{TARGET}}/... (for copy, copy_dir, patch).

skip_if_exists.description: If true, skips copying when destination file already exists (for copy, copy_dir).

exclude.description: Glob patterns to exclude when copying directories (for copy_dir).

render_filenames.description: Replace {{KEY}} placeholders in relative file/folder names (for copy_dir, default: true).

path.description: Directory path starting with a root placeholder prefix, e.g. {{TARGET}}/... (for mkdir).

anchor.description: Target file anchor text for insertion or replacement (for patch with insert_before, insert_after, replace).

content.description: Content string to insert, append, prepend, or replace (for patch).

skip_if_contains.description: Skip patch if the target file already contains this substring (for patch idempotency).

create_if_missing.description: Create target file if missing for append and prepend modes (for patch).

script.description: Relative path to script file inside knowledge unit folder (for run).

script_ref.description: Key in manifest.scripts to inherit file, interpreter, and timeout_ms (for run).

args.description: Command line arguments passed to script with {{KEY}} placeholder substitution (for run).

interpreter.description: Interpreter executable (for run; auto-detected from file extension if omitted).

cwd.description: Working directory for script execution starting with a root placeholder, e.g. {{TARGET}} (for run).

text.description: Progress message text with {{KEY}} placeholder substitution (for message).

timeout_ms.description: Step execution timeout in milliseconds (1000..600000, applies to run action).
